

FILE: src/quicksort.py
"""Ascending integer sort implemented as a pure function using quicksort."""


def quicksort(values: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Return a new list holding the same integers as values, ordered ascending."""
    if len(values) <= 1:
        return list(values)
    pivot = values[len(values) // 2]
    left = [v for v in values if v < pivot]
    middle = [v for v in values if v == pivot]
    right = [v for v in values if v > pivot]
    return quicksort(left) + middle + quicksort(right)
